title: Scheduled Maintenance: Database Replication Update
summary: We're performing planned database maintenance to change our replication mode, enabling read replicas and Change Data Capture (CDC) for improved scalability and reliability. While we've reserved a short maintenance window, we expect any disruption to last only a few seconds to minutes, during which Langdock may be briefly unavailable or slower than usual. No data will be affected. We've scheduled this during off-peak hours to minimize disruption. Thank you for your patience! The Langdock Team
